newsitem.title: FINLAND: VAISALA SEES SALES UP, GOOD PROFITABILITY.
newsitem.headline: VAISALA SEES SALES UP, GOOD PROFITABILITY.

text.p: Finnish meteorological equipment maker Vaisala Oy said on Monday it expected full-year 1997 net sales to exceed last year's and that profitability would remain good.

"The prospects for the rest of 1997 are good. The number of new orders has grown and we have a high backlog. We are set to exceed last year's net sales. Profitability will remain good," Vaisala said in a statement with its January-April results.
In 1996, Vaisala's net sales were 493 million markka. In January-April, net sales rose to 178 million markka from 147 in the year-ago period.
"All divisions reported growth in net sales compared to the previous year," Vaisala said.
At end-April, its order backlog stood at 205 million markka compared with 153 million one year earlier.

Vaisala's four-month profit before extraordinary items and tax rose to 40 million markka from 29 million. Operating profit at 43 million markka was 24 percent of net sales, up from 22 percent in the corresponding period in 1996.
